prize_parts.citation: for the development of targeted protein degradation, in which small molecules redirect the ubiquitin-proteasome system to remove disease-relevant proteins

statement.case_for: Targeted protein degradation is the strongest case for a new capability that the opening ballots converge on. It was the only candidate ranked in the top four by six members and in the top seven by seven. Its underlying principle is simple and can be explained to a broad audience: instead of occupying a protein's active site, a small molecule brings the protein to an E3 ligase and the cell's own machinery removes it. That is event-driven rather than occupancy-driven pharmacology, and it makes formerly undruggable targets reachable. This is the generative potential I look for. Crews and Deshaies introduced the heterobifunctional concept and proved it in 2001. Handa's identification of cereblon as the thalidomide target gave the molecular-glue branch its mechanism and explained a decades-old drug puzzle. A concept-plus-mechanism trio gives a coherent two-strand citation.
statement.case_against: The attribution problem is real. Ciulli (VHL ligands, ternary-complex structure), Sakamoto and Kim (first proof of concept), Gray, and Ito (with Handa on cereblon) all have credible claims, and a three-person cap excludes them. Maturity is also arguable, because clinical validation is incomplete and no degrader has yet reached approval at scale. A prize now would reward a concept ahead of its full clinical verdict. The two branches, PROTACs and glues, were discovered separately and may be better described as one platform than as one discovery.

responses.point: Somfai ranks Pd-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling (B069) first and calls it fully mature and overdue, with a clean Buchwald-Hartwig pair and conceptual simplicity.
responses.response: I agree that B069 has the cleanest attribution of any candidate and the best maturity profile, and I keep it as my first alternative. Where I differ is on what is new. The ligand-design logic is a refinement of a bond construction that the 2010 cross-coupling prize already framed. Degradation adds a mode of action, not a better route to a known bond. Neither of us has shown that the committee values attribution cleanliness over novelty of capability. If the group decides that clean credit and maturity should dominate, I could accept B069.

responses.point: Chabes ranks B045 first and treats it as turning the ubiquitin-proteasome machinery into a designable chemical tool, with mechanism well confirmed and approval still pending.
responses.response: I agree with this framing. Ternary-complex structures and degradation kinetics give the quantitative mechanistic evidence I want. I would press him on the molecular-glue strand, because cereblon-directed glues were found through drug mechanism rather than designed. That is why I would keep Handa in the trio rather than defend a PROTAC-only pair, and why the citation should name the principle of degradation rather than one compound class.

responses.point: Aqvist ranks lipid nanoparticles (B009) first as a game-changer with global consequences, and notes that base editing (B026) is cleanest as a Liu-only prize.
responses.response: The delivery impact of B009 is not in doubt, but I do not yet see a single chemical discovery that stands apart from the formulation engineering. The credit is spread across Cullis, Hope, Madden, MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer, and the committee would need to say what exactly was discovered and by whom. I am more persuaded by his Liu-only point on B026, since a trainee-inclusive prize is unusual. That still leaves the timing concern after the 2020 CRISPR prize.

responses.point: Brzezinski ranks long-range protein electron transfer (B006) first for its quantitative physical-chemical mechanism and clean Gray and Winkler attribution.
responses.response: B006 appeals to my physicist's preference for a quantitative principle, and the attribution is bounded. My reservation is the generative reach: it explains biological redox chains well, but it opens fewer new capabilities than a modality does, and it builds on Marcus theory recognized in 1992. I would like him to say what a prize citation would tell a broad audience that Marcus's did not.

uncertainties: Whether Ciulli should displace Handa or join him, which would require a four-person or two-part structure that the three-person cap does not allow.
Whether the absence of an approved degrader drug makes recognition premature compared with mature candidates such as B069.
Whether the glue and PROTAC strands can be cited as one discovery without distorting credit.
My opening first choice, B018, had no support beyond myself, so I should not assume its relative merit is shared.
statement.conflict_note: No specific conflict is apparent from my profile. I have no stated connection to any shortlisted candidate. I am a physicist at Lund, and colleagues Somfai and Sparr are also at Lund, but none of the candidates is linked to Lund in my profile.
